---
name: Feature request
about: Something ReviewStage should do, or do differently
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
---

## The problem

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way today? Describe the situation before the
solution — a reviewer's workflow, a team's constraint, a class of PR the review misses.

## Proposed change

What you would like to happen. If you have a design in mind, sketch it; if not, that is fine.

## Guardrails

ReviewStage never posts to GitHub without a human click, never posts as a bot, and never
requests changes. Does this proposal keep those properties? If it bends one, say why.

## Alternatives you considered

Other ways to get the same outcome, and why they fall short — including "edit the team skill"
or "add a `RISK_PATHS` rule", which cover more than they look like they do.

## Anything else

Links, screenshots, a sample `review.json`, prior discussion.
